Christopher Nolan Defends Creative Choices in 'The Odyssey'

Director Christopher Nolan has defended the creative liberties taken in his film 'The Odyssey' following criticism regarding historical inaccuracies. The film recently had a star-studded launch event in London ahead of its July release. The discussion highlights the tension between artistic interpretation and historical fidelity in filmmaking.
